name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Take the cleansed orb back to Menara in Ratchet, adventurer. Give her my regards and be safe. I truly hope you are able to withstand the temptation and corruption that is sure to come as you follow your path.

Good luck.
narrative.objectives: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, adventurer. This will do nicely.

The only thing left for you to do is to decide on which demon you want me to imprison within the cleansed orb. Do that, and you will have a magnificent new item to wield.
narrative.requestItemsText:
How goes your search for Tabetha and the orb, adventurer?

Tabetha has been more than useful when it comes to matters of the arcane. I'm sure she would have no problem aiding you if you're able to find her.

quests.name: Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Menara's acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet and choose one of their paths to follow. Afterwards, bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
quests.objectiveText: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.
